def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # The pattern forms an outlined winding corridor; paint background cells enclosed
    # by the 0/5-color line. Flood-fill exterior using 8-connectivity.
    line=next(v for v in set(sum(g,[])) if v not in (9,))
    seen=set(); stack=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r in (0,h-1) or c in (0,w-1)) and g[r][c]!=line:
                seen.add((r,c)); stack.append((r,c))
    while stack:
        r,c=stack.pop()
        for dr in (-1,0,1):
            for dc in (-1,0,1):
                y,x=r+dr,c+dc
                if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w and (y,x) not in seen and g[y][x]!=line:
                    seen.add((y,x)); stack.append((y,x))
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==9 and (r,c) not in seen: g[r][c]=4
    return g
PY
